reason: The parent preregistration requires duplicate physical WebFetch keys to have byte-equivalent parsed tool input JSON but did not define the deterministic serialization used to compare parsed JSON objects.

correction.parsed_tool_input_equivalence: Parse tool_input_json as a JSON object, then serialize that parsed object as UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted lexicographically, ensure_ascii=false, and separators ',' and ':' with no added whitespace. Duplicate physical keys are payload-equivalent only when these deterministic serialized bytes are identical.

consequence: If the same native physical key has different deterministic parsed-input bytes, fail closed. Otherwise retain one physical call and count the additional occurrence as a removed duplicate.
